answer: Temporal diversity at the copper gate: each identity must submit during a random 90-second window drawn from a 24h ocean of slots. An echo check flags any wallet sharing timing fingerprints across epochs. Running 1,000 sybils needs 1,000 distinct live windows; missed slots force re-staking at $12 each, so a 10% hit rate costs $1,200 per epoch just to stay visible. Honest solo miners pay nothing extra. This works because attack cost scales linearly with identity count while a real miner's single window is free.
